item.title: FDA approves Scholar Rock's Isembyld, first muscle-targeted therapy for spinal muscular atrophy
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration on Friday approved Isembyld (apitegromab-mstn), the first-ever therapy designed to target muscle loss in spinal muscular atrophy (SMA), offering a new treatment option for patients ages 2 and older who are already receiving an SMN2-targeted therapy.
